note: Minted 2026-08-27 (forge session, Kim's live ask: 'create a secondary export of our Factory skills as optimized Figma Skills'). Positives cover the two modes (net-new / convert a reference skill), the platform names (Figma agent, Figma Make custom skill), the lifecycle verbs (export, convert, port, regenerate, check), and the resolution-loss symptom. Negatives fence the same-plugin Figma siblings (make-figma-make-kit = a Make guidelines/ FOLDER, figma-plugin-facts = the Plugin API), harness:make-skill (a Claude Code skill), the Figma MCP skills family (figma-use etc., installed by a coding agent), the DESIGN.md format, and the canvas design tool. Re-derive when a sibling Figma-named skill lands. Extended 2026-08-27: sources now include command-species skills and agents/*.md (t13–t15); n11 fences authoring a Claude Code agent.
